options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of this resource.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: ike_version
options.description: IKE protocol version to use when establishing the VPN tunnel with peer VPN gateway. Acceptable IKE versions are 1 or 2. Default version is 2.

options.name: local_traffic_selector
options.description: Local traffic selector to use when establishing the VPN tunnel with peer VPN gateway. The value should be a CIDR formatted string, for example `192.168.0.0/16`. The ranges should be disjoint. Only IPv4 is supported.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the resource. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression `[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?` which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.

options.name: peer_external_gateway
options.description: URL of the peer side external VPN gateway to which this VPN tunnel is connected. This field represents a link to a ExternalVpnGateway resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_external_vpn_gateway task and then set this peer_external_gateway field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: peer_external_gateway_interface
options.description: The interface ID of the external VPN gateway to which this VPN tunnel is connected.

options.name: peer_gcp_gateway
options.description: URL of the peer side HA GCP VPN gateway to which this VPN tunnel is connected. If provided, the VPN tunnel will automatically use the same vpn_gateway_interface ID in the peer GCP VPN gateway. This field represents a link to a VpnGateway resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_vpn_gateway task and then set this peer_gcp_gat

options.name: peer_ip
options.description: IP address of the peer VPN gateway. Only IPv4 is supported.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: region
options.description: The region where the tunnel is located.

options.name: remote_traffic_selector
options.description: Remote traffic selector to use when establishing the VPN tunnel with peer VPN gateway. The value should be a CIDR formatted string, for example `192.168.0.0/16`. The ranges should be disjoint. Only IPv4 is supported.

options.name: router
options.description: URL of router resource to be used for dynamic routing. This field represents a link to a Router resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_router task and then set this router field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: shared_secret
options.description: Shared secret used to set the secure session between the Cloud VPN gateway and the peer VPN gateway.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: target_vpn_gateway
options.description: URL of the Target VPN gateway with which this VPN tunnel is associated. This field represents a link to a TargetVpnGateway resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_target_vpn_gateway task and then set this target_vpn_gateway field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: vpn_gateway
options.description: URL of the VPN gateway with which this VPN tunnel is associated. This must be used if a High Availability VPN gateway resource is created. This field represents a link to a VpnGateway resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_vpn_gateway task and then set this vpn_gateway field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: vpn_gateway_interface
options.description: The interface ID of the VPN gateway with which this VPN tunnel is associated.
